# PR #2132: Patch: the co-op board can show both duels at once

Closes #2095

This pass fixes the one blocking finding against #2095, on top of the branch's existing Both boards work. All earlier approvals carry over unless noted.

What changed in this pass
- `apps/web/src/duos/DuosBoard.tsx`: the portal (`duos-portal`) is now always mounted, in live games and replays. On a wide screen with Both on, the existing `duos.css` rule hides it; on a narrowed screen it is the flip control again. The `showing` state now drives both modes, so flipping the portal while Both is on swaps which board the narrow fallback draws. The pass drop accepts the teammate board or the portal while Both is on (narrow drops land on the portal, as today). The portal flash is no longer gated on single-board mode: on wide Both it flashes unseen behind `display: none`, and on narrow it flashes exactly as today's board does.
- `apps/web/src/duos/duos.css`: the narrow `@media (max-width: 600px)` block re-shows the portal when `data-both="true"` (`display: revert`, winning over the wide hide by source order) and draws only the showing board: `[data-showing="own"]` hides the teammate wrapper, `[data-showing="teammate"]` hides the own wrapper.
- Tests: `apps/web/src/duos/DuosBoard.test.tsx` — the "portal hides" test now asserts the portal stays mounted while Both is on (hidden by CSS on wide) and adds `R2095000 the portal still flips while both boards show, for a narrowed screen`, which flips `data-showing` with both boards mounted. `apps/web/src/test/ux/duos-ux.test.tsx` now asserts the wide portal-hide rule plus the narrow portal re-show and both showing-aware single-board rules.
- Docs: `spec/rulings/R2095000.md` and `apps/web/README.md` reworded from "portal hidden/removed" to "portal stays mounted, CSS-hidden on wide, flipping again on narrow". No spec index change (no new ruling).

Whether the finding held
- Held. `DuosBoard.tsx` rendered the portal only when `!showBoth` while `duos.css` hid `.duos-both-toggle` below 600px, so `both=true` persisted left a narrowed viewport with only the own board and no flip control, contradicting the task's "the board works as today, with the portal flipping". Fixed as above.

- `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/duos/DuosBoard.test.tsx src/test/ux/duos-ux.test.tsx`: 2 files, 63 tests passed (62 before plus the new narrow-flip test).

- Kept the portal in the DOM and hid it with the existing wide CSS rule rather than adding a JS width check, per CLAUDE.md rule 9 (no JS width number). The alternative of rendering the portal conditionally on viewport width was rejected for that reason.

```text
# #2095: Patch: the co-op board can show both duels at once
Opened by @jgoetzmann.

### What it does

In a co-op (2v2) game a player sees one duel at a time. The portal (`duos-portal`, "Teammate's board") flips the board between the player's own duel and the teammate's, which is read-only (SPEC §13.6, B63, `apps/web/src/duos/DuosBoard.tsx`). To follow the teammate's game, a player has to flip away from their own.

This patch adds a **Both boards** view: on a screen wide enough for two boards, the player can see the teammate's duel beside their own, both live.

- **The toggle.** "Both boards" (`duos-both`, `aria-pressed`) sits in the board rail beside the portal.
  - The choice is kept per device: `localStorage` under a key in `duos/config.ts`, read and written in `try`/`catch` as `CoopPanel.tsx` keeps its room.
  - It starts off, so nothing changes for a player who never presses it.
- **The player's own board** stays exactly as it is: `<Game view={view.own}>` with `legal`, passes, trades, pings and the rail.
- **The teammate's board** is the read-only board the portal shows today: `<Game view={view.teammate} legal={NOTHING} onAction={ignore} replay>`, placed beside the own board at a smaller scale.
  - Its cards can be hovered and inspected, and the ping wheel works on it (B64). A ping marker shows on whichever board shows its duel.
  - It plays no sound and no music. Today `useGameAudio` runs in every mounted `Game`, so two boards would play both duels' cues and fight over the music. Add the one prop Game needs for this (for example `silent`), and skip the audio feed when it is set. Don't draw a second kind of board: Game.tsx stays the one board (CLAUDE.md, Architecture).
  - Each board keeps its own `key`, so neither animates the other duel's events.
- **Passing.** While both boards show, a hand card dragged onto the teammate's board passes it when `legal` lists that pass, as a drop on the portal does (B62). Anything not listed sends nothing.
- **The portal** is hidden while both boards show, and comes back when the toggle is off.
- **Narrow screens.** Below the width where two boards fit, the toggle is hidden and the board works as today, with the portal flipping. Set this with a media query in `duos.css` at the breakpoint the Duos phone layout already uses, or with one named custom property if none fits. Add no JavaScript width number (CLAUDE.md rule 9).
- **Test ids.** Two Games draw the same test ids (`hero-you`, the zones, the hand). Wrap each board in its own element (`duos-board-own`, `duos-board-teammate`) so tests and specs can scope by board.
  - Unscoped selectors in `e2e/cypress/e2e/41-duos-coop.cy.ts` must still find the player's own board. That holds with the toggle off by default; scope any selector that would match both.
- **Out of scope:** the co-op replay (`DuosReplay.tsx`) keeps its portal flip.

**Spec.**
- §13.6's sentence "A portal on the board flips it to the teammate's duel, read-only: …" gains: on a screen wide enough, the player may instead show the teammate's duel beside their own, still read-only and silent.
- Add a ruling note in this issue's own block (R<this issue>000, `docs/issues-and-patches.md`, Ruling numbers). It records the toggle, its per-device default, the silent read-only second board, the drop-to-pass, and the narrow fallback.
- Then run `cargo jackioh spec index`.
- `apps/web/README.md`'s "Play together and Duos" section names the toggle and its ids.

Only `apps/web` changes, plus the spec and `e2e/support/testids.ts`. No server, engine, card or AI change.

### Acceptance

Vitest, in `duos/DuosBoard.test.tsx` with tests named after the new ruling (`it("R<n> …")`), plus a CSS check in `test/ux/` like the board-ux tests:

- With the toggle on, both boards render, the teammate's inside `duos-board-teammate`. The own board still sends duel moves and passes.
- Clicking the teammate's board sends nothing.
- The choice survives a remount (storage), and it starts off with nothing stored.
- A ping made on the teammate's board is sent, and its marker shows there.
- Dragging a listed pass onto the teammate's board sends that pass. An unlisted card sends nothing.
- The teammate's board feeds no audio: the audio stub sees only the own board's views.
- The portal is hidden while both boards show, and back when the toggle is off.
- `duos.css` hides the toggle below the breakpoint and falls back to one board there.
- `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, `pnpm --dir apps/web test`, `pnpm exec eslint apps/web e2e` and `cargo jackioh spec check` pass.

### Blocked by, part of

Part of #1888.
